paper_title: Investigating the gamma-ray burst from decaying MeV-scale axion-like particles produced in supernova explosions
notes: SN 1987A gamma-ray decay bound on ALP-photon coupling from SMM non-observation, extended to ma~280 MeV via photon coalescence. This is a stellar/SN bound (not a DM haloscope), so no local DM density applies. The exclusion is a 2D region in the (g_agamma, ma) plane; exact numerical points are not tabulated in the text so the data points here are rough reads of the exclusion boundary from the described figure (roughly g_agamma ~ 1e-11 to few-e-12 GeV^-1 over ma ~ 10 keV to 280 MeV). Values are approximate; the paper's primary result is a figure (Fig. 3) without a data table.
